definitions.gloss: marriage registration form; notification of marriage
definitions.explanation: The official document submitted to a local government office to legally register a marriage in Japan. Submitting this form is what makes a marriage legally valid — no ceremony is required.

examples.japanese: {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
examples.english: To submit a marriage registration form.

examples.japanese: {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}には{証人|しょうにん}が{二人|ふたり}{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: Two witnesses are needed for a marriage registration form.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{記念日|きねんび}に{合|あ}わせて{市役所|しやくしょ}に{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}を{出|だ}しに{行|い}った。
examples.english: The two went to the city hall to submit their marriage registration form on their anniversary.

notes:
Composed of {婚姻|こんいん} (marriage) and {届|とどけ} (notification/report). In Japan, marriage becomes legal when this form is accepted at a municipal office — no wedding ceremony is legally required. The form requires signatures from the couple and two adult witnesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}を{出|だ}す: to submit a marriage registration
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a marriage registration (formal)
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}が{受理|じゅり}される: the marriage registration is accepted
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}: how to fill out a marriage registration

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many couples choose a meaningful date to submit their {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}, such as a holiday, anniversary, or auspicious day. Some municipal offices accept forms 24 hours a day. Recently, some municipalities offer decorative {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ} designs featuring local characters or landmarks.

RELATED WORDS:
- {離婚届|りこんとどけ}: divorce registration form
- {出生届|しゅっしょうとどけ}: birth registration form
- {入籍|にゅうせき}: entering the family register — often used colloquially as a synonym for getting legally married
